The goal isn’t to *force* others to act but to set an example. If everyone waited, the system would naturally balance out. - *"Isn’t this just passive?"* - No—it’s an active choice to uphold moral principles. Passivity would be ignoring the problem entirely. ### **Conclusion** Your action aligns with centuries-old ethical frameworks in East Asia.
